meta_description: Tyler Plastering & Building in Bristol offers expert plastering, rendering, and building services. Fast, reliable work across Eastville and surrounding areas. Call now.
hero_subhead: Whether you need interior plastering, exterior rendering, or repair work, we deliver flawless finishes on time and on budget across Bristol.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Building Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: From feature walls and skimming to rendering and external repairs, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Wall and ceiling skimming, patch repairs, and smooth finishes ready for decoration. We work fast without compromising quality, leaving your rooms looking immaculate.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Durable cement, silicone, or acrylic renders that protect your property and enhance its appearance. Includes crack repairs and weatherproofing to extend building life.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of textured Artex ceilings and walls, replaced with smooth modern finishes. We handle all debris disposal and make good any damage underneath.

services.title: Damp & Crack Repairs
services.desc: Identify and repair water damage, rising damp, and structural cracks before replastering. Proper diagnosis ensures the problem doesn't return.

services.title: Feature Walls & Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Textured finishes, venetian plaster, and bespoke wall treatments that add character to your home. Bespoke designs tailored to your taste and style.

services.title: Coving & Cornice Installation
services.desc: Professional fitting of ceiling coving and period cornicing to add elegance and finish to any room. Includes repairs and restoration of existing mouldings.

about_pullquote: I take pride in finishing work that looks perfect every single time.
about_para_1: Tyler Plastering & Building was founded on the principle that skilled plastering doesn't have to cost the earth or take forever. Based in Eastville, Bristol, we've spent over 15 years honing our craft — from tight domestic runs to larger commercial projects. Every job, big or small, receives the same meticulous attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, quote fairly, and deliver exactly what we promise. We're not cowboys racing through rooms — we're craftspeople who care about the finish. Whether you're renovating a Victorian terrace, upgrading a new-build, or tackling damp repairs, you'll work with someone who genuinely knows the trade.

reviews.text: Tyler came to do some skimming after we'd had a leak sorted. He was efficient, tidy, and the finish is flawless. We've recommended him to three neighbours already. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Needed exterior rendering done on our Victorian terrace. Tyler matched the original texture perfectly and the whole job took just over a week. Competitive price and he cleaned up after himself — rare these days.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had Tyler in to repair damp patches and re-plaster the sitting room. He explained what the damp was caused by, sorted it properly, and didn't just cover it up. Peace of mind and beautiful finish. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Mark S.
